Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `819933fee01b779b7f0c4ab8057cfd883882651b` on `orchestrator/project-3243` (matches the integration branch metadata).

Clarification mapping:
- No `Q1`/`Q2` batch was needed; clarify already marked the issue clear and auto-posted `/answer`.

Current-head re-validation:
- `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh` already writes the three relevant caches: `PR_META_FILE`, `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON`, and `LINKED_ISSUE_FALLBACK_NUMBERS_JSON`.
- The late workflow steps `Mark linked issues ready to merge`, `Mark linked issues review-blocked (autofix exhaustion)`, and `Mark linked issues review-blocked (workflow failure)` already consult those caches before any live `/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}` fallback. So `MERGE-002` is partially landed already; the remaining work is cleanup/tightening, not first-time caching.
- Conflict: `post-merge-validate-dispatch` is a separate job from `codex-agent`, so it cannot directly reuse runtime files from `Collect PR metadata` today. Reuse there has to be wired through job outputs (or a similar cross-job handoff), not by reading `PR_META_FILE` directly.
- Conflict: top-level PR reviews are currently always folded into `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE`, which is embedded into reviewer/editor prompts. Gating `/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}/reviews` is therefore a deliberate reduction of default prompt context, even though the file contract can remain stable.

Implementation plan

1. Files likely to change
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`
- `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh`
- `tests/test_review_autofix_phase_transition_contract.py`
- `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`
- Possibly `tests/test_review_rereview_and_approval_rubric.py` if the break-glass wiring assertions need to move with the new fetch gate.

2. Functions / modules to implement
- In `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` `gate`:
  - Add compact merged-PR outputs for the post-merge path: cached PR text (`title`/`body`) and cached linked-issue metadata (`number` + label names only).
  - Populate those outputs only when `post_merge_dispatch=true`, so open-PR review runs do not pay extra cost.
- In `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` `Dispatch standalone validate for orchestrator short-circuit issues`:
  - Consume the gate outputs first.
  - Keep the current GraphQL/issue-view fallback only for true cache miss or malformed output.
  - Remove the common-path per-issue label re-reads when cached labels are already present.
  - Use cached PR title/body (or existing workflow inputs) before any live `/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}` fallback.
- In the three late linked-issue label steps:
  - Preserve the current cache order (`LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` -> `LINKED_ISSUE_FALLBACK_NUMBERS_JSON` -> `PR_META_FILE`).
  - Tighten the final `/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}` read so it is only the fail-open path for missing/malformed cache state, not a parallel duplicate source.
  - Keep the existing strict repo-scoped fallback helper and do not revisit parser semantics.
- In `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh`:
  - Stop fetching `/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}/reviews` unconditionally.
  - Default `PR_REVIEWS_FILE` to `[]`.
  - Only fetch top-level PR reviews when the feature that consumes them is enabled (`REVIEW_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED`, plus any narrowly scoped aggregate-context opt-in if inspection shows one is truly needed).
  - Keep generating `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE` even when reviews are skipped, with `reviews_count: 0`.

3. Data structures affected
- Internal workflow job outputs for merged-PR cache handoff:
  - compact linked-issue JSON (`number`, `labels`)
  - PR text or equivalent cached title/body payload
- `PR_REVIEWS_FILE` remains the same file path/contract, but default contents can now legitimately be `[]`.
- `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE` format stays the same; it may simply report `reviews_count: 0` and omit `kind: review` entries on the default path.
- Keep `PR_META_FILE` and `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` names unchanged; no public rename/reformat is required.

4. API / interface changes
- No public env-var, file-name, or workflow-input rename.
- `PR_META_FILE`, `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON`, `PR_REVIEWS_FILE`, and `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE` remain backward compatible by name.
- The only new interface should be internal workflow job outputs inside `review_autofix.yml`.

5. Potential risks / edge cases
- GitHub job-output size limits: keep the merged-PR handoff compact (issue number + label names only; no issue bodies).
- `workflow_dispatch` or older callers may omit PR title/body inputs; preserve the existing live `/pulls/{PR_NUMBER}` read as the final fail-open path.
- Non-default-base PRs can still produce empty `closingIssuesReferences`; preserve the strict repo-scoped fallback flow already implemented by `tighten-review-linked-issue-fallbacks`.
- Break-glass-enabled runs must still have populated `PR_REVIEWS_FILE`; do not change `REVIEW_BREAK_GLASS_ENABLED` defaults or enabled-path behavior.
- Reviewer/editor scripts currently treat `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE` as opaque text, not structured review-count logic; that is what makes the default-path review-fetch gating safe.

6. Testing considerations
- Extend `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`:
  - default path: no `/pulls/{PR}/reviews` call, `PR_REVIEWS_FILE == []`, `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE` still exists and reports `reviews_count: 0`
  - break-glass-enabled path: `/pulls/{PR}/reviews` is still fetched and preserved in both `PR_REVIEWS_FILE` and `PR_ALL_COMMENTS_CONTEXT_FILE`
  - existing strict linked-issue fallback tests stay green
- Extend `tests/test_review_autofix_phase_transition_contract.py`:
  - assert the post-merge validate step consumes cached merged-PR metadata before live fallbacks
  - assert the late linked-issue steps still prefer cached PR/body data and only use live `/pulls` reads on cache failure
- If workflow env wiring changes around break-glass, update `tests/test_review_rereview_and_approval_rubric.py` accordingly.
- Targeted verification after implementation:
  - `pytest tests/test_review_autofix_phase_transition_contract.py`
  - `pytest tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`
  - `pytest tests/test_review_rereview_and_approval_rubric.py` (if touched)

Assumptions
- No wrapper workflow change is needed because `review_autofix.yml` already defines `pr_title` and `pr_body` inputs.
- Scope stays limited to review-autofix workflow/helper/test files; no batching/refactor work outside this area.
- `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` remains out of scope.

Actions taken:
- Inspected `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh`, and the existing review-autofix contract tests to validate the current-head callsites before planning.

Missing-context notes:
- None beyond the cross-job cache-handoff limitation noted above.
